theorems.name: OrionHiddenState.classifyBoundedness
theorems.statement: ∀ {defect threshold : Nat},   defect ≠ 0 →     ¬threshold ≤ defect → OrionHiddenState.classifyDefect defect threshold = OrionHiddenState.DefectMode.boundedness

theorems.name: OrionHiddenState.classifyGap
theorems.statement: ∀ {defect threshold : Nat},   defect ≠ 0 → threshold ≤ defect → OrionHiddenState.classifyDefect defect threshold = OrionHiddenState.DefectMode.gap

theorems.name: OrionHiddenState.hiddenStatePrinciple

theorems.name: OrionHiddenState.quantitativeTransfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : OrionHiddenState.HiddenStateSystem) (x : S.X), S.residue x ≤ S.transfer (S.signature (S.π x))
